raw_definitions: Definisi : adj sendirian, hanya seorang; (of st) hanya /satu, se + approp classifier/: on the beach was a ~ fisherman, di pantai, ada nelayan yg sendirian; the Prime Minister was accompanied by a ~ escort, Perdana Menteri diiringi oleh hanya seorang pengawal; among the batiks was a ~ example of one drawn by hand, antara batik-batik itu terdapat hanya satu contoh batik tulis; all that was left in the clearing was a ~ coconut tree, yg tinggal di cerang itu hanya sebatang pokok kelapa. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
